packageRules.description: Wait before adopting new npm releases, so compromised or yanked versions are caught first
Group non-major npm updates into one PR
Major updates can break things CI misses: open the PR, but merge by hand
Stay on the Node 22 LTS line; a Node major is a deliberate upgrade (also update engines and esbuild --target)
Hold npm majors: npm 12 fails --package-lock-only on Tailwind 4 (https://github.com/npm/cli/issues/9800); re-enable once fixed
Pin the Dockerfile base image to a digest
GitHub Actions don't change the app: use ci(deps) so git-cliff skips them for releases (grouping comes from the shared preset)
Pre-commit hooks don't change the app either: use ci(deps), label them, and don't pin digests (the pre-commit manager cannot write a digest into rev:)
